description.short: Click a target in any video and track it frame-by-frame with XMem segmentation, running fully on the Snapdragon NPU.
description.long: Track-Anything lets you click one or more targets on the first frame of a video and produces an output video with the target mask-overlaid on every frame. It runs the Track-Anything (XMem) ONNX models on the Qualcomm NPU via QAI AppBuilder's OnnxRuntimeContext with HTP acceleration. Models are auto-downloaded from the Qualcomm AI Hub public asset bucket on first run; a default surfing clip is fetched if you don't provide your own video. Point selection uses matplotlib so it works with the headless OpenCV build shipped on Windows on ARM.
